findings.title: Synthetic Namespace consumes one real-declaration slot in linker
findings.proof: F11 defaults.declarations=256. F13 indexes arena.root Namespace before real declarations, then refuses any index call when scopes.len()==256. Thus256realdeclarations require257scopes and finaldeclaration refuses.
findings.repro_source_recipe: 'package P {' + ''.join('part def T%d;' % n for n in range(255)) + '}'
findings.observed: Source-proven; runtime repro not executed by audit worker
findings.expected: 256realdeclarations accepted throughout parser/linker/import/export; synthetic root excluded from real-declaration limit
findings.fix_pr: One focused linker boundary fix plus256/257boundary tests and actual F14 integration case; publicnamedconstant for realdeclaration budget recommended

findings.title: Selected semantic-ID typing and native node-ID JSON contracts have no explicit bridge
findings.proof: F14 calls Transaction::type_part_usage with target.element_id. F33 passes FeatureTyping wire values unchanged to F04 Registry.resolve, which interprets bare UUID as JSON node ID. Ordinary distinct IDs yield Unresolved; allowed cross-domain ID collision may resolve another same-class target.
findings.observed: Source-proven contract incompatibility; runtime repro not executed
findings.expected: Explicit conversion API with input/output identity-domain tags, validating full selected type/typedFeature associations before any replacement; no fallback guessing in F04/F33
findings.fix_pr: Separate bounded selected-to-native FeatureTyping identity bridge crate/API with actual F14->bridge->F33->reload->bridge->F34 roundtrip fixtures and cross-domain collision cases
scope: new standalone bridge crate; exact API and snapshot composition coordinator-owned
